recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change Bundle source for FHIR-28364 unless the work group separately decides to encode every granular batch/transaction fullUrl exception as a machine-checkable FHIRPath invariant.

Current source/fhir.ini keeps Bundle in active build scope.
